source.note: Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets (master) + allStat_gen skillParam. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Levels: Lv10, except constellation-boosted talents of 4-star characters at Lv13 (C6 assumed). Normal/charged/plunging default to physical unless the sheet overrides the element (infusions are NOT applied). 2026-08-07: A4 Blazing Eye added as its own rotation target passive2/dmg (ATK x 80%, Pyro, counted as Charged Attack DMG so it takes charged_dmg_/pyro_dmg_ and her C2 charged CRIT Rate). It is a separate damage instance that fires only when a Charged Attack CRITs, so the hit def carries triggerCritRateScaled and the evaluator multiplies it by the capped crit rate under avgHit — GO models it identically as passive2.probabilistic_dmg. This replaces the old a4BlazingEye conditional, which folded charged_dmgIncFromAtk_ 0.8 into every Charged Attack hit: that both ignored the CRIT requirement and multiplied the proc by the CA target's rotation weight. 2026-08-08: the hit was originally keyed passive2/dmg, which broke the file's own "hit keys match GO target paths" rule — every hand-authored rotation copies GO and says passive2/probabilistic_dmg, and resolve_hit_definition exact-matches a character's own keys, so those targets silently scored 0. probabilistic_dmg is now the canonical key; passive2/dmg is kept as an alias so any rotation drafted against the old spelling still resolves.

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Burst Done Deal: while Brilliance is active, Yanfei's Charged Attack DMG is increased by 62.2% (burst Lv13, the level this file stores the burst at since burst is her C5-boosted talent and 4-stars assume C6). Brilliance lasts 15s on a 20s cooldown, so set an uptime on this condition for the share of the rotation it actually covers rather than leaving it at full.
A1 Proviso: when Yanfei consumes Scarlet Seals via a Charged Attack, each Seal consumed increases her Pyro DMG Bonus by 5% for 6s (base kit max 3 Seals; the 4th-Seal state requires C6 Extra Clause).

C2 Right of Final Interpretation: increases Yanfei's Charged Attack CRIT Rate by 20% against enemies below 50% HP. Since the opponent is only under that threshold for part of a rotation, the partial-uptime states pro-rate the 20% by the share of the rotation spent below 50% HP.

auto.name: Seal of Approval
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Shoots fireballs that deal up to three counts of <e:pyro>Pyro DMG</e>.
When Yanfei's Normal Attacks hit enemies, they will grant her a single Scarlet Seal. Yanfei may possess a maximum of 3 Scarlet Seals, and each time this effect is triggered, the duration of currently possessed Scarlet Seals will refresh.
Each Scarlet Seal will decrease Yanfei's Stamina consumption and will disappear when she leaves the field.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes Stamina and all Scarlet Seals before dealing <e:pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</e> to opponents after a short casting time.
This Charged Attack's AoE and DMG will increase according to the amount of Scarlet Seals consumed.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Gathering the power of Pyro, Yanfei plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <e:pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</e> upon impact with the ground.

skill.name: Signed Edict
skill.desc: Summons blistering flames that deal AoE Pyro DMG. Opponents hit by the flames will grant Yanfei the maximum number of Scarlet Seals. Apart from their legal uses, Yanfei's seals also come with her customized additional terms and conditions. Well, it's not as if the Ministry of Civil Affairs can change the laws of nature.

burst.name: Done Deal
burst.desc: Triggers a spray of intense flames that rush at nearby opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG, granting Yanfei the maximum number of Scarlet Seals, and applying Brilliance to her. Brilliance Has the following effects: · Grants Yanfei a Scarlet Seal at fixed intervals. · Increases the DMG dealt by her Charged Attacks. The effects of Brilliance will end if Yanfei leaves the field or falls in battle. "Here are the full terms for this matter of life and death — by which I mean my life and your death!"

passives.name: Proviso
passives.desc: When Yanfei consumes Scarlet Seals by using a Charged Attack, each Scarlet Seal will increase Yanfei's <e:pyro>Pyro DMG Bonus</e> by 5%. This effect lasts for 6s. When a Charged Attack is used again during the effect's duration, it will dispel the previous effect.

passives.name: Blazing Eye
passives.desc: When Yanfei's Charged Attack deals a CRIT Hit to opponents, she will deal an additional instance of <e:pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</e> equal to 80% of her ATK. This DMG counts as Charged Attack DMG.

passives.name: Encyclopedic Expertise
passives.desc: Displays the location of nearby <k>resources unique to Liyue</k> on the mini-map.

constellations.name: The Law Knows No Kindness
constellations.desc: When Yanfei uses her Charged Attack, each existing Scarlet Seal additionally reduces the stamina cost of this Charged Attack by 10% and increases resistance against interruption during its release.

constellations.name: Right of Final Interpretation
constellations.desc: Increases Yanfei's Charged Attack CRIT Rate by 20% against enemies below 50% HP.

constellations.name: Samadhi Fire-Forged
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Signed Edict</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Supreme Amnesty
constellations.desc:
When <k>Done Deal</k> is used:
Creates a shield that absorbs up to 45% of Yanfei's Max HP for 15s.
This shield absorbs <e:pyro>Pyro DMG</e> 250% more effectively.

constellations.name: Abiding Affidavit
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Done Deal</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Extra Clause
constellations.desc: Increases the maximum number of Scarlet Seals by 1.

auto.name: Sceau embrasé
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Tire des boules de feu qui infligent jusqu'à 3 vagues de <e:pyro>DGT Pyro</e>.
Lorsqu'une attaque normale touche un ennemi, Yanfei obtient un sceau écarlate. Yanfei peut détenir un maximum de 3 sceaux écarlates, et chaque fois que cet effet se déclenche, la durée des sceaux en sa possession est réinitialisée.
Chaque sceau écarlate diminue la consommation d'endurance de Yanfei, et disparaît lorsque Yanfei quitte le champ de bataille.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance et tous les sceaux écarlates pour infliger des <e:pyro>DGT Pyro de zone</e> aux ennemis en face de Yanfei après un court délai.
La portée et l'intensité de ces DGT Pyro de zone augmentent avec le nombre de sceaux écarlates consommés.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Yanfei concentre son énergie Pyro et plonge depuis les airs pour frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des <e:pyro>DGT Pyro de zone</e> à l'impact.

skill.name: Pacte des flammes
skill.desc: Yanfei en appelle aux flammes dévastatrices, infligeant des DGT Pyro de zone. Lorsque des ennemis sont touchés, Yanfei gagne le nombre maximum de sceaux écarlates. En plus de leur valeur juridique, les sceaux de Yanfei présentent des conditions d'utilisation très personnalisées. Après tout, ce n'est pas comme si le Bureau des affaires civiles pouvait changer les lois de la nature.

burst.name: Application des peines
burst.desc: Invoque une explosion de flammes intenses qui jaillit vers les ennemis proches, infligeant des DGT Pyro de zone et conférant à Yanfei le nombre maximum de sceaux écarlates, tout en appliquant l'effet Brillance. Brillance Confère les effets suivants : · Confère à Yanfei un sceau écarlate à intervalles réguliers. · Augmente les DGT infligés par ses attaques chargées. Les effets de la brillance se dissipent lorsque Yanfei quitte le champ de bataille ou qu'elle est vaincue. « Veuillez trouver ici les termes de cette question de vie ou de mort, et par là j'entends ma vie et votre mort ! »

passives.name: Dispositions supplémentaires
passives.desc: Lorsque Yanfei consomme un sceau écarlate en utilisant une attaque chargée, chaque sceau écarlate augmente le <e:pyro>bonus de DGT Pyro</e> de Yanfei de 5 % pour 6 s. Utiliser une attaque chargée avant la fin de la durée d'un effet dissipe l'effet précédent.

passives.name: Œil de la justice
passives.desc: Quand les attaques chargées de Yanfei infligent des coups CRIT aux ennemis, elle inflige des <e:pyro>DGT Pyro de zone</e> supplémentaires équivalant à 80 % de son ATQ. Ces DGT sont considérés comme des DGT d'attaque chargée.

passives.name: Connaissance du terrain
passives.desc: Affiche l'emplacement des <k>produits de Liyue</k> sur la mini-carte.

constellations.name: Plaidoyer convaincant
constellations.desc: Lorsque Yanfei utilise une attaque chargée, chaque sceau écarlate existant diminue sa consommation d'endurance de 10 % supplémentaires et augmente la RÉS à l'interruption lors de son déclenchement.

constellations.name: Verdict final
constellations.desc: Le taux CRIT des attaques chargées de Yanfei augmente de 20 % lorsqu'elles touchent des ennemis dont les PV sont inférieurs à 50 %.

constellations.name: Mise sous scellés
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Pacte des flammes</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Droit commun
constellations.desc:
<k>Application des peines</k> confère les effets suivants :
Génère un bouclier qui absorbe une quantité de DGT équivalant à 45 % des PV max et dure 15 s.
Le bouclier est efficace à 250 % contre les <e:pyro>DGT Pyro</e>.

constellations.name: Déclaration sous serment
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Application des peines</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Clause complémentaire
constellations.desc: Augmente le nombre maximum de sceaux écarlates de 1.
